errorPatterns._comment: Error patterns: { id: unique identifier, watchFor: [scenarios to watch before execution], matchWhen: [keywords to match after error], cause: root cause, solution: solution, lesson: lesson/principle }. Append here after AI resolves errors

examples.cause: Config file deleted accidentally or node_modules not installed

examples.lesson: Backup before modifying config, periodically verify node_modules integrity
